oneLine: Clarid Pharmaceuticals filed a DRHP with SEBI for an upcoming IPO.

sources.title: Clarid Pharmaceuticals Limited ने SEBI के पास DRHP दाखिल किया

synopsis: Claroid Pharmaceuticals Limited has filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Board of India to raise funds through an initial public offering. The proposed IPO consists of a fresh issue of up to 74,50,000 equity shares and an offer for sale of up to 51,50,000 equity shares, totaling up to 1,26,00,000 equity shares with a face value of Rs. 10 each. The proceeds from the fresh issue will be utilized to fund capital expenditure for establishing a new manufacturing unit on existing land for products such as injections, ampoules, vials, dry powders, pre-filled syringes, and eye drops. OneView Corporate Advisors Private Limited and Valmiki Leela Capital Private Limited are acting as the book running lead managers for the offer.
